final: WITH counts AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM manager_award WHERE player_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_id), total AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt FROM counts) SELECT c.player_id, c.cnt, CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / t.total_cnt AS fraction FROM counts c CROSS JOIN total t WHERE t.total_cnt IS NOT NULL ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10
